svg.title: Evidence III — QR Shield layered URL analysis
svg.desc: Plate showing a QR code dissolving into a decoded, defanged example URL, which then passes through five ordered layers: feedback overrides; reputation checks (blacklist, raw-IP host, suspicious TLD); pattern checks (homograph, punycode, obfuscation, typosquat); a gradient-boosting model over 30 lexical features; and live verification of SSL and redirects. A 0–100 score scale ends the plate.
svg.text: DECODE THE IMAGE · INTERROGATE THE URL · THEN DECIDE
illustrative URL — layers run in this order
